description: ImplementedDEVS2_Lighting, the interface specification rearlight.ldf handed to the DEVS2 supplier, satisfies the interface side of EL-HAZ-1.4.2 (DEVS2_Lighting_HazardWarning): DEVS2 subscribes to ReqLeft and ReqRight of DEVMLIN01Fr01.
